data.name: Azhaan
data.gender_notes: Azhaan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who shines and illuminates with his knowledge and actions. The name Azhaan carries the meaning “Radiant, Bright, Shining” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Azhaan usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant, bright, shining and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child who is expected to be a beacon of light and knowledge in his community
data.etymology: Azhaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Radiant, Bright, Shining.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azhaan total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: عزهان
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من عزhan، يعني الشخص الذي له عز ورفعة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عزهان هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، مشتق من الجذر اللغوي 'عز' الذي يعني الرفعة والعزة. يدل على الشخص الذي يتمتع بعز ورفعة، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم عدة مرات في سياقات مختلفة، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَلِلَّهِ الْعِزُّ وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ' (سورة المنافقون: 8). يستخدم هذا الاسم في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية كدلالة على الشخص الذي يتصف بالعزة والكرامة.

in_urdu.name: عزہان
in_urdu.meaning: عزت و رفعت والا، بلند کردار شخص
in_urdu.long_meaning: عزہان ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو عزت و رفعت کا حامل ہو، بلند کردار والا ہو۔ اس نام کی اصولی جڑ 'عز' ہے جو عربی میں عزت اور رفعت کے معنی رکھتی ہے۔ اسلامی تقویم میں، عزت اور رفعت کو اہم صفات माना جاتا ہے، جیسے کہ قرآن مجید میں ہے: 'وَلِلَّهِ الْعِزُّ وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ' (المنافقون: 8) ۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیا سمیت مختلف اسلامی ثقافتوں میں استعمال ہوتا ہے تاکہ عزت اور کرامت کے حامل شخص کو مخاطب کیا جا سکے۔

in_hindi.name: अज़हान
in_hindi.long_meaning: अज़हान एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है आदरणीय, सम्मानित, और उच्च चरित्र वाला व्यक्ति। इस नाम की मूल जड़ 'अज़' है, जिसका अर्थ अरबी में सम्मान और आदर होता है। इस्लामी परंपरा में, सम्मान और आदर को महत्वपूर्ण गुण माना जाता है, जैसा कि कुरआन में कहा गया है: 'व लिल्लाहि अल-इज़्ज़ु व ली रसूलिहि व लिल-मु'मिनीन' (अल-मुनाफिकून: ८)। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय सहित विभिन्न इस्लामी संस्कृतियों में प्रयोग किया जाता है ताकि सम्मान और गरिमा के धारक व्यक्ति को संबोधित किया जा सके।

in_pashto.name: عزہان
in_pashto.long_meaning: عزہان د مذکر نوم دی چی د عربی ژبې نه اخیستل شوی دی. دغه نوم د هغه چا معنی دی چی عزت او لوړتیا لری، لوړ پوړی شخص دی. د عزہان نوم اساسی ريښه 'عز' ده چی په عربی کی د عزت او لوړتیا معنی ورکوي. په اسلامي دود کی، عزت او لوړتیا مهم صفات ګڼل کیږي، لکه څنګه چی په قرآن کریم کی راغلی ده: 'وَلِلَّهِ الْعِزُّ وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ' (المنافقون: ۸). دا نوم په افغانستان او پاکستان کی د پښتو ژبی د مسلمانانو په جامعه کی کارول کیږي تا عزت مند او لوړ پوړی شخص ته خطاب ورکړي.

in_english.name: Azhaan
in_english.meaning: Person of dignity, honor, and high character
in_english.long_meaning: Azhaan is a masculine given name derived from Arabic roots. It signifies a person of dignity, honor, and high moral character. Etymologically, it stems from the Arabic root 'az', which connotes meanings of dignity, honor, and loftiness. In Islamic tradition, these qualities are highly esteemed, as reflected in the Quran: 'And to Allah belongs [all] honor, and to His Messenger, and to the believers' (Quran 63:8). Historically, the name Azhaan has been used across various Muslim cultures to denote individuals who embody these noble attributes. It symbolizes strength of character and spiritual integrity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Azhaan holds great cultural significance in the Islamic community as it signifies an individual who is a source of guidance and knowledge. The name is associated with professionals such as scholars, imams, preachers, and teachers who illuminate the path for others through their wisdom and guidance.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Azhaan holds deep meaning as it represents an individual who seeks to illuminate their own path towards Allah by acquiring Knowledge, acting on it, and sharing it with others. The Islamic tradition places great emphasis on the pursuit of knowledge as a means to gain nearness to Allah, and those who are known as Azhaans are seen as being deeply committed to this cause. In essence, the name Azhaan is a reminder to strive for knowledge and wisdom, and to use it to guide and illuminate the path for others towards Allah.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Radiant, Bright, Shining" symbolizes One who shines and illuminates with his knowledge and actions. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Azhaan serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of radiant, bright, shining.

historical_references.reference: Azhaan was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and is mentioned in Sahih Bukhari and Sahih Muslim.

trends: Azhaan is a popular name for boys in the Muslim world
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Azhaan remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
